title: Power and Performance Delivery
summary: Feedback on power and performance is mostly favorable when sentiment is explicit, but many sampled fragments mention power without enough context for a firm sentiment reading.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong engine output, confident power delivery, and satisfying acceleration or overall driving feel.

negative.summary: Negative reviews are limited, with one clear complaint about insufficient engine power and another sampled fragment that does not provide enough topic-specific detail to explain the negative assignment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention power or performance in isolation or too briefly to confirm whether the sentiment is favorable, unfavorable, or merely descriptive.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are extremely short or lack context, which limits sentiment interpretation.
One negative example appears unrelated to power or performance, so the negative theme is supported by very little concrete evidence.
The sample includes many undetermined snippets, so the explicit sentiment examples do not capture the full topic content.
